notes: `כָּזֹה וְכָזֶה` gives one English word to each preposition-plus-demonstrative pair, fused under rule 30 and headed on the demonstrative, which carries the content (rule 23).

The resultative `לְ` of `לְכֹהֵן` is unrepresented because the written `הָיָה` carries the whole *am become* frame (rule 21), and the dative `לוֹ` is unrepresented while its suffix takes the possessive *his* (rule 40).
